{"summary":"Colleague (v1.76.0) is a swappable coder-agent harness — \"one runtime, many minds\" — that turns model backends into repo workers behind one shared task contract. It is a headless task runtime, not a chat assistant or IDE plugin.\n\nMain parts: the Task/TaskResult contract (colleague/contract.py + contract_* siblings), the bounded tool loop (colleague/loop.py + 26 loop_* modules), repo-confined tools (colleague/tools.py: read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_dir, run_command, culture, devague, subagent, subagents, finish), backend adapters (colleague/engines/), plugin discovery via the colleague.engines entry-point group (colleague/registry.py), the JSON run artifact (colleague/artifact.py), opt-in OpenTelemetry telemetry (colleague/telemetry/), git/PR handoff (colleague/handoff.py), the doctor health check (colleague/oilcheck/), and the checksum-based approval gate (colleague/policy.py). All contract-level features (hooks, telemetry, gates) live in the runtime loop, never in backends — the all-engines rule.\n\nTwo bundled backends: mock (deterministic, networkless, contract reference) and vllm-openai (any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint; default model unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4).\n\nEntry points: colleague and clg → colleague.cli:main.
